title: CCNA Foundations: Network Decisions and Evidence
summary: Ten original lessons extend Packet Trail into switching control, IPv6, route preference, OSPF, services, wireless and typed automation through fixed offline models.
limits: No equipment, emulator, network traffic, credentials, APIs or configuration changes are used. All device and service validations remain unperformed. Selected conceptual alignment to CCNA 200-301 v1.1 is partial; no complete coverage, exam readiness or production approval is claimed. Cisco states v1.1 through 2027-02-02 and v2.0 from 2027-02-03; this workshop does not map v2.0. Official indexed topics were reviewed, with direct page/PDF retrieval limitations explained in the coverage guide.
